name: dumax-hub
description: Dumax Hub — hub empresarial: recrutamento, clima, demandas, chat interno, organograma e métricas.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @dumax/api" "npm run dev -w @dumax/web"
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate -- --name init && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dumax/api && npm run build -w @dumax/web
